part_path.description: Absolute path to the .prt file to add as a component

name.description: Instance name for the new component (e.g. "BRACKET_1")

position.description: Transformation matrix [4x4] or [x,y,z] position for the component

nx_add_component.description: Add a component from a .prt file to the current assembly. Maps to ComponentAssembly.AddComponent(partPath, name).

component.description: Component name to be constrained (moved), e.g. STAND

mate_type.description: Touch|Concentric|Fix|Distance|Parallel|Perpendicular|AlignLock|Angle|Center12|Bond|Fit (11 types; AlignLock/Angle use geometry axis with usesAxis=true; Bond uses component-level reference with no geometry; Center12 requires to2_component/to2_geom)

to_component.description: Reference component name (not needed for Fix type)

to_geom.description: Reference geometry journal id (face format: FACE 120 {(0,0,0) EXTRUDE(1)}; Features|... composite strings are not resolvable)

to2_component.description: Center12 second reference component name (required, Center12 only)

to2_geom.description: Center12 second reference geometry journal id (required, Center12 only; format same as to_geom)

nx_mate_component.description: Apply an assembly constraint (11 types: Touch/Concentric/Fix/Distance/Parallel/Perpendicular/AlignLock/Angle/Center12/Bond/Fit) between components (Positioner direct mode. ClearNetwork→Begin→Establish→CreateConstraint(true)→type/alignment→refs→FixHint→Solve→ClearNetwork→End)

nx_list_components.description: List all components in the current assembly. Iterates over the root component's children and reports their names.

component.description: Name of the component to reposition

nx_reposition_component.description: Move a component by translation and rotation offsets. Computes a rotation matrix from Euler angles (XYZ order, degrees) and applies it via ComponentAssembly.MoveComponent().

component.description: Name of the component instance to remove from the assembly

nx_remove_component.description: Remove a component from the current assembly. Maps to ComponentAssembly.RemoveComponent(target).

component.description: Name of the component to suppress

suppress.description: true to suppress, false to unsuppress

nx_suppress_component.description: Suppress or unsuppress a component in the assembly. Maps to ComponentAssembly.SetComponentSuppression(target, suppress).

axis.description: Rotation axis for circular pattern (edge or vector)

angle_span.description: Total angle span (degrees) for circular pattern

spacing.description: Spacing between instances (mm) for linear pattern

nx_component_pattern.description: Create a component pattern (linear or circular) in the assembly. Linear: requires spacing, direction (X/Y/Z), and count. Circular: requires axis (X/Y/Z), direction, count, and optional angle_span. Uses ComponentAssembly.CreateComponentPatternBuilder().

components.description: Array of two component names to check for interference

nx_interference_check.description: Check for interference/overlap between assembly components. Maps to ComponentAssembly.CheckInterference(compObjects). If the components array is empty, checks all components. Returns a list of interference pairs with overlap volume.

explode.description: true=create/update explode, false=restore and delete all explodes (default true)

layout.description: none (empty explode) | linear (per-component linear extrapolation, verified via UF ExplodeComponent) | nx_auto (NX automatic)

spacing.description: Linear layout spacing mm (default = assembly bbox max dimension × 0.5 / component count, minimum 20)

scale.description: Spacing multiplier (formerly a dead parameter, now fixed to actually take effect)

components.description: Only lay out specified component names (default = full tree)

nx_explode_assembly.description: Create or modify an explode view of the assembly. layout=none (empty explode) | linear (linear extrapolation per component, verified via UF ExplodeComponent) | nx_auto (NX automatic). Options: per-component offset, scale factor, selective components. Default: all components, linear along Z.

nx_correct_face_geometry.description: [未实现] 修正面的曲面类型（B_SURFACE → PLANE/CYLINDER 等）。NX2412 API 不可用，请在 NX GUI 中手动操作。

new_parameters.description: Optional parameter overrides for the rebuild

feature_name.description: Feature name or tag to rebuild

nx_rebuild_feature.description: Rebuild a feature with new parameters. Updates expression values on the existing feature. Preserves design intent by transferring unchanged parameters. NX2412: Features.DeleteFeature() and Features.Update() don't exist. Use expression update only - NX automatically updates the model.

mark_id.description: Undo mark ID to roll back to

nx_rollback_to_mark.description: Rollback the model to a previous undo mark (pmark). Useful for 'undo-retry' correction strategies. NX2412: Session.GetUndoMarkCount() doesn't exist. Use Session.GetAllVisibleUndoMarks() and Session.UndoToMark() instead.

parameters.description: Additional parameters for the repair action

entity_id.description: Entity to apply the fix to

nx_apply_suggestion.description: Apply a correction suggestion from nx_validate_model. Automatically fixes issues like short edges, tolerant edges, small faces. NX2412: Most auto-fixes require manual intervention (edge.GetFeature/DeleteFeature don't exist). Returns guidance for each issue type.

curve_tags.description: Curve tags or indices to project

nx_project_curve.description: Project Curve - project curves onto faces or planes. Runtime probe (2026-07-31): SectionToProject (Section) + FaceToProjectTo (SelectObjectList)

curve_tags.description: Curve tags or indices to offset

nx_offset_curve.description: Offset Curve — offset curves by distance in a plane. Verified on NX2412. Supports inward/outward offset with optional trim/extend.

nx_intersection_curve.description: Intersection Curve - create curves at the intersection of two face sets. Runtime probe: FirstFace/SecondFace (ScCollector) - use AddFaceToCollector rules

reference.description: Reference entity (face, plane, or point) depending on type

principal_type.description: XY, XZ, or YZ for principal method.

nx_create_datum_plane.description: Create a datum plane in the work part. Supports methods: principal (XY/XZ/YZ), offset (from face/datum), through_face (coplanar to face/datum), and three_points (reserved).

nx_create_datum_axis.description: Create a datum axis in the work part. Supports methods: edge (from existing edge), cylindrical_face (from cylindrical face), two_points (reserved), intersection (reserved).

nx_create_datum_csys.description: Create a datum coordinate system (CSYS) in the work part. Creates 3 datum planes (XY, XZ, YZ) and 3 datum axes (X, Y, Z) at the specified origin. Axes are computed from user-provided X and Y direction vectors, with Z as cross product.

nx_create_point.description: Create a datum point in the work part. Supports methods: coordinates (from XYZ values), intersection (two curves/edges), projection (project a point/curve along a direction), and midpoint (midpoint of an edge/curve).

visible.description: true to make visible, false to hide

nx_set_layer_visibility.description: Sets the visibility of a layer (show or hide).

objects.description: Selection or list of objects to move

nx_move_to_layer.description: Moves objects to a specified layer.

objects.description: List of object names to color.

nx_set_object_color.description: Sets the display color of objects.

objects.description: List of object names to modify.

path.description: Full path for the new part file (e.g., "C:/temp/test.prt").

nx_create_part.description: Create a new NX part file at the specified path. Maps to Session.Parts.FileNew() with blank template.

path.description: Absolute path to the .prt file to open

nx_open_part.description: Open an existing NX part file. NX2412: OpenBaseDisplay(string) 1-param overload removed. Strategy: try OpenBaseDisplay(string, string[]) first, then Open(string).

nx_save_part.description: Save the currently active (work) part. Maps to Part.Save(SaveComponents.True, CloseAfterSave.False).

path.description: Absolute path for the new .prt file

nx_save_as.description: Save the current work part to a new file path. Maps to Part.SaveAs(path).

nx_close_part.description: Close the currently active (work) part. Contract (M-008): can only close the current work part; cannot close a specific named part. Unsaved changes are discarded without prompting.

path.description: Absolute path for the output .stp file

nx_export_step.description: Export the current work part to STEP, IGES, STL, or Parasolid format. Uses Session.DexManager.CreateStepCreator(), CreateIgesCreator(), CreateStlCreator(), or CreateParasolidTranslator() respectively.

path.description: Absolute path to the file to import (.stp, .igs, .sat, etc.)

nx_import_geometry.description: Import geometry from STEP, IGES, or Parasolid files into the current work part. Uses Session.DexManager.CreateStepImporter(), CreateIgesImporter(), or CreateParasolidImporter() based on file extension.

nx_list_open_parts.description: List all currently open parts in the NX session. Iterates Session.Parts and reports name, path, and work-part status.

body_id.description: Body tag or index to inspect; empty = first solid body

include_convexity.description: Include convexity info for each edge

nx_inspect_topology.description: Inspect the B-rep topology of bodies in the work part. Returns body->face->edge hierarchy with surface types, face adjacency graph (Phase 0.1), and optional edge convexity (Phase 0.2) via UFEval. detail_level: 'summary' (counts only), 'full' (faces+edges+FAG), '1-ring' (faces only). include_convexity: true to compute CONVEX/CONCAVE/SMOOTH per edge.

face_id.description: Face tag or index to evaluate

px.description: X coordinate of query point (for closest_point/ray mode)

nx_evaluate_face.description: Evaluate a face's normal vector at a given (u,v) parameter or at the closest point to a probe point. Uses UF.UFEval (Phase 0.2). Modes: 'parametric' — provide (u, v); 'closest_point' — provide (px, py, pz).

nx_inspect_geometry.description: Extract detailed geometric definition of a face, edge, or vertex. Returns surface/curve parameters, control points, normals, tolerances. Set include_xt=true to include Parasolid XT node reference for deep inspection.

nx_inspect_feature_tree.description: Inspect the feature tree with design intent extraction. Returns feature parameters, output faces, parent sketches, and status. Extends nx_list_features + nx_get_feature_info with structured intent data.

filename.description: Absolute path for the output .xt file

nx_export_xt.description: Export the current work part as a Parasolid XT file. Returns the file path, schema version, and node count. NX2412: Part.ExportParasolid doesn't exist. Use Session.DexManager.CreateParasolidExporter.

xt_path.description: Path to the .xt file to inspect

node_index.description: Specific node index within the XT tree

nx_inspect_xt_node.description: Query a single node from a Parasolid XT file by 1-based index. Returns the node type, node_id, name, and all parsed fields. Supports V35 schema with node-id to index cross-referencing. Use after nx_export_xt to do deep geometry inspection.

nx_inspect_selection.description: Inspect currently selected objects in NX (faces/edges/bodies/components/drafting objects). Uses UI.SelectionManager to read the live selection, then describes each object: Face  → SolidFaceType + AskFaceData (pt/dir/radius/bbox) + area Edge  → SolidEdgeType + length Body  → face/edge counts Component → name/part/transform DraftingView/DraftingCurve → type info Feature → feature type

nx_measure_distance.description: Measures the minimum distance between two named objects in the work part.

nx_measure_angle.description: Measures the angle between two named objects in the work part.

body.description: Target body name. Default: all bodies.

nx_measure_volume.description: Measures the volume of a body (or all bodies) in the work part.

body.description: Target body name. Default: all bodies.

nx_measure_mass_properties.description: Calculates mass, center of mass, and moments of inertia for a body.

curves.description: List of curve or edge names to measure.

nx_measure_perimeter.description: Measures the total perimeter/length of curves or edges.

faces.description: List of face names to measure.

nx_section_analysis.description: Performs section analysis on a body at a specified plane.

sketch_name.description: Name of the sketch to extrude (falls back to most recent)

distance.description: END limit value (Limits.EndExtend, absolute from section plane; NOT extrude length). Default 10.

start_distance.description: START limit value (Limits.StartExtend, absolute from section plane). Default 0.

end_condition.description: Warning: currently NOT applied (echo only, not applied to builder). Only supports Limits value semantics.

target.description: Boolean target body: body name / journal_id / tag. Must be explicitly specified when multiple bodies exist, otherwise error.

seed_point.description: Region selection (verified in 96.6% of human-authored journals): "x,y,z" seed point to isolate one region from the curve soup. Uses ScRuleFactory.CreateRuleFaceFeatures with FaceHoleSeedPoint.

seed_points.description: Multi-region union — semicolon-separated seeds "x,y;z;x,y,z". Each seed creates a separate region rule, added sequentially with Boolean.Add.

curve_indices.description: Constrain region boundary to a 1-based curve subset of the sketch, e.g. "1,3,5" (by sketch GetAllGeometry order). Human region arrays are often the true boundary of the .prt curves.

curve_names.description: Same as above but select by curve name (takes priority over curve_indices). Names are more stable than indices: .prt preserves NX auto-names (Arc1, Line2...).

nx_extrude.description: Extrude a section or sketch by a given distance. seed_point/seed_points provide region selection (verified). curve_indices/curve_names constrain region boundary to a subset of sketch curves.

returns.name: feature
returns.desc: JournalIdentifier like "EXTRUDE(2)" (NX2412 Name is empty; use as reference)

returns.name: body
returns.desc: JournalIdentifier of the created body (empty if boolean=subtract removed it)

sketch_name.description: Name of the sketch to revolve (falls back to most recent).

axis.description: Axis of revolution: X, Y, Z (UPPERCASE only; default Z). Verified across all committed revolve cases.

target.description: Boolean target body: body name / journal_id / tag. Must be explicitly specified when multiple bodies exist.

seed_point.description: Region selection: "x,y,z" seed point to isolate one region from the curve soup, then revolve it. Verified: 35 committed Revolve cases use this approach.

seed_points.description: Multi-region union, semicolon-separated "x,y;z;x,y,z". Same as nx_extrude.

curve_indices.description: Constrain region boundary to a 1-based curve subset of the sketch (e.g. to exclude isolated lines). Human region arrays are often the true boundary of .prt curves.

curve_names.description: Same as above, select by curve name (takes priority over curve_indices). Verified: ASSEMBLY_14_PART_4 uses curve_names successfully.

nx_revolve.description: Revolve a section or sketch around an axis. seed_point/seed_points provide region selection (verified). curve_indices/curve_names constrain region boundary.

returns.name: journal_id
returns.desc: 特征句柄 "REVOLVE(2)" (NX2412 Name 为空, 用此引用)

nx_unite_all.description: Unite ALL solid bodies in the work part into one (unite everything). No parameters. Used when feature output produces multiple bodies (e.g. multiple closed loops in sketch).

returns.name: united
returns.desc: bodies_after < bodies_before 时为 true（静默 no-op 可见）

returns.name: merged_from
returns.desc: 参与合并的实体名列表（journal_id 或 tag=...）

returns.name: sheets_skipped
returns.desc: 被跳过的片体数（>0 时出现）

section.description: Name of the section curve or sketch

guide.description: Name of the guide curve or sketch

target.description: Boolean target body: body name / journal_id / tag. Must be explicitly specified when multiple bodies exist.

nx_sweep.description: Sweep a single section along a guide curve ("Sweep Along Guide" in NX). Verified via committed journal cases.

returns.name: journal_id
returns.desc: 特征句柄 "SWEEP(2)" (NX2412 Name 为空, 用此引用)

edges.description: List of edge names to blend

nx_blend.description: Create an edge blend (fillet) on specified edges.

returns.name: journal_id
returns.desc: 特征句柄 "BLEND(2)" (NX2412 Name 为空, 用此引用)

edges.description: List of edge names to chamfer

angle.description: Angle in degrees for angle-offset chamfer

nx_chamfer.description: Create a chamfer on specified edges. Supports symmetric, asymmetric, and angle-offset modes.

x.description: X coordinate of hole center (must be ON target body surface)

face_reference.description: Face name for target body resolution

nx_hole.description: Create a hole feature at the specified location. NX2412 uses HolePackageBuilder (verified). Supports simple hole, countersink, counterbore; depth, diameter, tip angle all configurable.

reference_x.description: X coordinate of pattern reference point

reference_y.description: Y coordinate of pattern reference point

reference_z.description: Z coordinate of pattern reference point

path.description: Path curve for pattern along curve

plane.description: Mirror plane or pattern plane reference

y_count.description: Number of instances in Y direction

nx_pattern.description: Create a feature pattern of any supported type. Pattern types: rectangular | circular | along path | mirror | polygon | helix | spiral | fill. Each type has its own parameter set; unspecified parameters use NX defaults.

targets.description: Target bodies: body name / tag number / feature journal_id (first item = Target, rest are also targets; NX allows multiple targets in one Boolean).

tools.description: Tool bodies: body name / tag number / feature journal_id

nx_boolean.description: Perform a boolean operation (unite, subtract, intersect) between bodies.

name.description: Name of the feature to delete

journal_id.description: JournalIdentifier of the feature (works for unnamed features)

nx_delete_feature.description: Delete a feature by name or journal_id. Returns available features if not found.

params.description: Key-value pairs of parameter names to new values

nx_edit_feature.description: Edit a feature's parameters by updating its expressions.

nx_rebuild_model.description: Trigger model rebuild after expression changes. UpdateManager.DoUpdate(UndoMarkId) + Session.SetUndoMark NX2412 runtime: no-arg DoUpdate() does NOT exist — must pass UndoMarkId

body.description: Name of the body to mirror

plane.description: Name of the datum plane for mirroring

nx_mirror_body.description: Mirror a body across a datum plane.

faces_to_remove.description: Face names to remove (empty = inner hollow).

face_tags.description: Face tags to remove (NX2412 faces are nameless;

body.description: Target body: body name / journal_id / tag (must be explicitly specified when multiple bodies exist).

target.description: Body or face to shell (hollow out)

thickness_flip.description: Flip shell direction (default true = inward, verified on NX2412 2026-09-01)

nx_shell.description: Shell (hollow out) a body by removing faces and offsetting the remaining walls to a uniform thickness.

returns.name: journal_id
returns.desc: 特征句柄 "SHELL(2)" (NX2412 Name 为空, 用此引用)

fixed_edge.description: Edge or plane defining stationary reference

nx_draft.description: Apply a draft angle to faces relative to a pull direction.

cutting_tool.description: Face, plane, or body used as cutting tool

nx_trim_body.description: Trim a solid body using a plane or face as the cutting tool.

nx_loft.description: Create a lofted solid/surface through two or more cross-section sketches.

nx_tube.description: Create a tube/pipe feature along a guide curve.

body.description: Name of the body to split

cutting_tool.description: Face, plane, or body used to split

nx_split_body.description: Split a solid body using a plane or face as the cutting tool.

faces.description: List of face names to offset

nx_offset_surface.description: Offset faces of a body by a distance.

sheets.description: List of sheet body names to sew

nx_sew.description: Sew multiple sheet bodies into one.

sheet_body.description: Name of the sheet body to thicken

direction.description: Thicken direction: X, Y, Z (default Z)

nx_thicken.description: Thicken a sheet body into a solid.

axis.description: Axis direction: X, Y, Z (default Z)

nx_helix.description: Create a helix curve. Output curve/feature auto-named HELIX{N}. Parameters: number of turns, pitch, radius, right/left hand, taper angle, limits.

nx_text_curve.description: Create planar text as curves (TextBuilder, Types.Planar). Verified 2026-08-04: Features.CreateTextBuilder(null) — NXOpen.Features.TextBuilder TextString (string), Type = Types.Planar, SelectFont(font, script) PlanarFrame = RectangularFrameBuilder (CoordinateSystem + Length/Height Expression + UpdateOnCoordinateSystem)

nx_sketch_status.description: Read sketch solver status: status enum, dof, constraint total, update scope.

details.description: Include per-constraint geometry and expression details (default: true).

nx_sketch_constraints.description: Enumerate sketch constraints: per-type counts, geometry, and driving expressions.

nx_intent_snapshot.description: Composite snapshot: feature tree, expressions, sketch status, constraint counts, optional body measure.

nx_create_sketch.description: Create a new sketch on the specified reference plane (XY, XZ, or YZ). Uses NX2412 CreateNewSketchInPlaceBuilder(None) and iterates Datums to find the matching datum plane reference.

name.description: Curve name (set AFTER AddGeometry, for nx_sketch_fillet/chamfer resolution).

nx_sketch_line.description: Create a line in the active sketch from (x1, y1) to (x2, y2). Uses Curves.CreateLine and sketch.AddGeometry. Re-activates the sketch after each operation to keep it active.

nx_sketch_arc.description: Create an arc in the active sketch given center, radius, start and end angles. Uses Curves.CreateArc(center, xDir, yDir, radius, startRad, endRad). Angles are converted from degrees to radians.

nx_sketch_rectangle.description: Create a rectangle in the active sketch from corner (x1, y1) to (x2, y2). Constructs four lines connecting the corners in order.

nx_sketch_circle.description: Create a circle in the active sketch from center point and radius. Uses Curves.CreateArc with a full 2*PI sweep (circle is a 360-degree arc).

targets.description: Array of sketch entity indices to constrain

nx_sketch_constraint.description: Apply a constraint to sketch geometry. Supports geometric constraints: horizontal, vertical, parallel, perpendicular, tangent, equal_length, fix, coincident, midpoint, concentric. Supports dimensional constraints: dimension (requires 'value' parameter).

nx_finish_sketch.description: Finish (exit) the currently active sketch. NX2412: Deactivate requires two arguments — ViewReorient and UpdateLevel.

nx_sketch_trim.description: Trim sketch curves to their intersection points with boundary curves. Uses Features.CreateTrimCurveBuilder for each curve.

points.description: List of [x, y] points (sketch-local) the spline passes through.

nx_sketch_spline.description: Create a spline curve through a series of points in the active sketch. Uses Curves.CreateSplineByPoints with a Point3d array.

nx_sketch_mirror.description: Mirror sketch geometry across a centerline. Uses Curves.CreateMirrorCurve for each curve, then adds results to the sketch.

nx_sketch_ellipse.description: Create an ellipse in the active sketch. Uses Curves.CreateEllipseBuilder with center, major/minor radii, and rotation angle. Rotation angle is converted from degrees to radians.

distance.description: Offset distance (mm; sign depends on side).

nx_sketch_offset.description: Offset sketch curves by a specified distance. Uses Curves.CreateOffsetCurveBuilder for each curve. Side parameter: 'left', 'right', or 'both' (default 'right').

nx_list_sketches.description: List all sketch names in the work part.

nx_sketch_fillet.description: Create a fillet (rounded corner) between two sketch curves. Uses SketchCollection.CreateFilletBuilder() (NX2312+ internal API). Verified 2026-08-04: CurvesToFillet = SelectNXObjectList.Add(NXObject) FilletRadius = Expression.Value, CreateRadiusDimension (bool), LockRadius (bool) ThirdCurve (NXObject) + DeleteThirdCurve (bool) for 3-curve fillets

nx_sketch_chamfer.description: Create a chamfer between two sketch curves. Uses SketchCollection.CreateSketchChamferBuilder() (NX7.5+ public API). Verified 2026-08-04: CurvesToChamfer = SelectDisplayableObjectList.Add(DisplayableObject) ChamferOption = ChamferOptions.Symmetric/Asymmetric/OffsetandAngle Distance1/Distance2/Angle = Expression.Value, TrimInputCurves (bool)

closed.description: Close the surface (loop back to first curve)

nx_through_curves.description: Through Curves — loft through multiple section sketches. Source: FeatureCollection.CreateThroughCurvesBuilder; SectionsList (SectionList)

nx_ruled.description: Ruled Surface — simple ruled surface between two section curves. Source: FeatureCollection.CreateRuledBuilder; FirstSection/SecondSection (Section)

nx_studio_surface.description: Studio Surface — freeform surface through section and guide curves. Source: FeatureCollection.CreateStudioSurfaceBuilder; SectionList/GuideList (SectionList)

nx_extend_surface.description: Extend Surface — extend sheet body edges. Source: verified on NX2412. Supports extend to face, by distance, or to plane.

face_tags1.description: First set of face tags for mid-surface

face_tags2.description: Second set of face tags for mid-surface

nx_midsurface.description: Mid Surface — create midsurface between opposing faces. Verified 2026-08-17 (NX2412): FacePairing = NXOpen.GeometricUtilities.FacePairingBuilder; InputSolidBodies (ScCollector, CreateRuleBodyDumb+ReplaceRules) + IncludeFace(face) → Commit. CollectorPairList path NOT used (throws "constrained property out of limits").

diameter.description: New diameter value (mm) for cylindrical faces

offset.description: Offset distance in mm (0 is rejected).

nx_fit_view.description: Fit all visible objects in the graphics viewport. Maps to NXOpen Part.ModelingViews.WorkView.Fit().

nx_set_view.description: Set the graphics view orientation (front, back, top, bottom, left, right, isometric, trimetric). Maps to NXOpen View.Orient() with the corresponding ViewOrientation enum.

nx_undo.description: Undo the last visible operation. NX2412: UndoLastNVisibleMarks requires 3 parameters: (int n, out bool marksRecycled, out bool undoUnavailable). Falls back to UndoToLastVisibleMark() if the 3-param version is not available.

path.description: Absolute path for the screenshot image file

nx_screenshot.description: Capture the current graphics viewport as a PNG image. Uses UFSession.Disp.CreateImageExportBuilder() for viewport capture.

path.description: Journal file path, must end in .cs (.NET).

nx_run_journal.description: Execute an NX .NET journal (.cs) file. Python (.py) journals are not supported: NX2412 removed Session.ExecuteJournal() and no replacement exists — convert the journal to .cs.

nx_record_start.description: [未实现] 开始录制 NX Journal。NX2412 已移除 Session.BeginJournalRecording()，请使用 NX 菜单 Tools > Journal > Record。

nx_record_stop.description: [未实现] 停止录制 NX Journal。NX2412 已移除 Session.EndJournalRecording()，请使用 NX 菜单 Tools > Journal > Stop。

nx_list_undo_marks.description: List all available undo marks (pmarks) for rollback. NX2412: Session.GetUndoMarkCount() doesn't exist. Use Session.GetAllVisibleUndoMarks() instead.

nx_path.description: Path to ugraf.exe. Optional — when omitted it is auto-detected (UGII_BASE_DIR, then NX_ROOT, then a scan of Program Files\Siemens\NX*); if nothing is found the call fails with an error instead of guessing a path.

custom_dir.description: Path to custom_dirs.dat, exported as UGII_CUSTOM_DIRECTORY_FILE. Optional — auto-detected next to the plugin directory.

nx_open.description: Launch Siemens NX with the MCP plugin loaded via PowerShell Start-Process (tries pwsh.exe, then Windows PowerShell 5.1). nx_path is optional and auto-detected. If NX is already running the call returns already_running instead of launching a second instance.

force.description: If true, kill the process immediately. Default: false.

nx_close.description: Close all open parts and exit Siemens NX, discarding all unsaved changes. force=true kills the NX process immediately; if the graceful close fails the tool falls back to killing the process.

view_name.description: Name of the view to activate (case-insensitive).

nx_activate_view.description: Activate (set as WorkView) a modeling view by name, or list all available views when no name is given.

nx_probe_builder.description: Probe a builder's real API via reflection. Params: factory (string) — e.g. "CreateAdmResizeFaceBuilder"

nx_validate_model.description: Validate the current model for topology, geometry, intent, or manufacturability issues. Based on Parasolid V35 rules. Returns a structured validation report. Supports validation_type: topology, geometry, intent, manufacturability, all.

nx_validate_feature.description: Validate a single feature by name. Checks feature health, output body validity, and degenerate geometry. Features are identified by name (case-insensitive).

body_tags.description: Body tags to create associative links for

nx_wave_link.description: WAVE Link - create associative linked copy of geometry from another part. Forum-verified (2026-07-31): WAVE link requires OCCURRENCE body, not prototype. Path: workPart.BaseFeatures.CreateWaveLinkBuilder → ExtractFaceBuilder.BodyToExtract.Add(occurrenceBody) Assembly mode: component.FindOccurrence(prototypeBody) → occurrence Single-part mode: body directly via ExtractFaceBuilder (same-part WAVE)

nx_extract_geometry.description: Extract Geometry - extract faces from a body as separate geometry. Runtime probe: FacesToExtract (SelectFaceList) + Associative (bool writable)

bodies.description: Body name / journal id list (with matching); default = all solid bodies in the work part

names.description: Per-body component names (default = body name with brackets removed, uppercased)

dir.description: Directory for new .prt files (default = work part directory)

keep_originals.description: true=copy and keep original bodies; false=move (NX default, originals deleted)

fix.description: Fix component after creation (default true, asm-06 Positioner Fix recipe)

nx_create_component.description: Create new component(s) (.prt) from work part bodies and assemble them into the current assembly. Each body becomes a separate component in its own .prt file.

bodies.description: Body name list (default = all solid bodies)

nx_find_same_bodies.description: Find bodies with identical geometry (19.1 algorithm: centroid + surface sampling distance sequence, relative tolerance). Returns groups of matching body names.

bodies.description: Body name list (default = all solid bodies)

dir.description: Directory for new .prt files (default = work part directory)

fix.description: Fix all components after creation (default true)

nx_bodies_to_assembly.description: Convert bodies of a multi-body part into an assembly (19.1 related). Each body becomes a component in a new .prt file, then assembled into the work part.

nx_asm_constraints.description: List assembly constraints per component: type, alignment, solver status and geometry references.

tree.description: Also output nested level tree (default false)

nx_bom_extract.description: Extract BOM data (part name × quantity × level) from the full assembly tree. Returns flat list and optionally nested tree structure.
